1.body:
Hello,

I saw your opening for a Website Designer at Boch & Fernsh, and I was drawn to your focus on niche, hand made designs over templates.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I have designed over 100 digital and print creatives, focusing heavily on layout, typography, and visual hierarchy. I also use Figma and Photoshop daily for visual assets and landing page layouts.

You can see my work in Bounceless, a case study demonstrating my approach to clean verification interfaces: https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/

I am currently based in Nagpur, am ready to relocate to Mumbai for this on-site role, and can start immediately. Would you be open to a quick look at my portfolio?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/
